summary: Moggill Road clearway kerb with tow-away signs; arterial lane, steep.
reasons: Kerb is a live arterial lane

drivers.seclusion: Outbuildings 14-24 m along the line; dwellings 57 m behind, so not exposed.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb sits on a live arterial lane with no pull-off; clearway bars stopping.
drivers.convention: Odd cars stop at the kerb, but the signed clearway prohibits it in the day.

sun_shade: Open at the kerb; trees shade the north verge.
